evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; required growth-atmosphere verification is unavailable.
Pressure was 2.938 Torr at growth onset with Ar 100.4 sccm.
Pressure has progressively risen to 3.208 Torr despite essentially constant Ar flow; this is concerning but no growth pressure tolerance or normal reference is supplied.
Temperature 750.3 C and Ar 100.1 sccm track setpoints of 750 C and 100 sccm; controller reports running.
